dependency_review: commander 12.1.0 implements the declared optional CLI parser.
@antv/l7-utils and @antv/l7-core 2.22.0 were downloaded without installing or executing package code.
laravel-lang/publisher 16.8.0 was reviewed as one compatible resolution, not proof of every possible version allowed by the dependency range.
rule_review: Node cluster: source module must be cluster or node:cluster. A function or imported member named cluster is not a module import. Import facts include named members, so the matcher uses syntax-bound module sources.

fw: relocate HTTP telemetry atom to data/property/access, describe only the property name, and use parsed member facts to exclude CSS selectors and comments. Update the cloaking consumer; its other required legs still supply intent.

Nodeunit: remove duplicated generic CommonJS object-export atom; retain assertion-pattern recognition through the canonical metadata export trait. Ordinary export objects cannot suppress unrelated analysis as Nodeunit evidence.

CLIENT_SECRET declaration: property/assign, not credential acquisition. Preserve the matcher and notable severity, remove inherited attack mappings and describe declaration rather than embedded secret value.
Spread charcode array: data/decode/charset, not credential acquisition. Preserve matcher and notable severity; update consumer.

Long string concatenation: data/string/concat, not legacy data/source. Preserve matcher, exclusions, thresholds and notable severity; update all exact consumers. No data/source ancestor selectors consume this atom.

Node readdirSync: fs/directory/readdir, not legacy fs/enumerate. Preserve matchers and scope; rename stat/push co-occurrence so it does not claim recursion. Update exact consumers and retain legacy directory selector alternatives in directory-enumeration-with-node-listing. The other ancestor consumers have Python-only or PE-only scopes, excluding these JavaScript atoms.
controls: cases.json contains positive and near-miss fixtures for module identity, property reads, export/assertion context, character decoding, secret declarations, directory operations and concatenation.
limits: Static source-flow extraction reports explicit incompleteness on several Figma files; direct code review was used to trace their behavior.
binwalk is absent from PATH; archive structure was inspected with standard parsers and rizin confirmed the npm archive is not executable machine code.
Upstream equality is corroboration; the benign judgments are based on source behavior, not registry reputation alone.
